details: Iraq's central bank has devalued its currency, a move that is reportedly facing opposition from some members of parliament. This economic policy shift could impact regional stability and investor confidence.
title: Iraq Devalues Currency Amidst Political Opposition

details: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned to the United States following a record-breaking deployment that supported the war on Iran. This development may signal a potential de-escalation of military presence in the region.
title: USS Abraham Lincoln Returns from Deployment Supporting Iran War

details: Bitcoin's price recently experienced a decline, trading 2.7 percent lower over a 24-hour period, as renewed attacks in the Strait of Hormuz led to a rise in oil prices and long-term US Treasury yields. This event also pulled traditional stocks back from recent records.
title: Bitcoin Slides Amidst Renewed Strait of Hormuz Attacks
